snippet.title: Silent Nights: The Pianist
snippet.description:
iPad: http://bigfi.sh/1auvznF
iPhone: http://bigfi.sh/1exkEOb

You and your sister, Yvette, come from a long line of gifted musicians. Explore hidden object scenes and get to the bottom of things in this amazing Collector's Edition!

• YOUR SISTER HAS BEEN ABDUCTED!
When you arrive to accompany her at a vocal concert in your hometown, you discover she has been abducted. You must find out why!

• UNCOVER A DIABOLICAL PLAN
You find out that a mysterious group, with plans to use Yvette's talents for a dire purpose, is responsible. Can you save her?

• UNLOCK THIS INCREDIBLE COLLECTOR'S EDITION TO ACCESS BONUSES
Enjoy wallpapers, concept art, a musical soundtrack and a bonus chapter of the story to play through!

• USE YOUR WITS TO FIND THE TRUTH
Uncover the secrets of an ancient organization before your sister's voice is silenced forever.

TRY IT FREE, THEN UNLOCK THE FULL ADVENTURE FROM WITHIN THE GAME!
